phases.claim_or_design: The documentary adversarial protocol is sufficient to prevent unsupported publication claims.
phases.challenge_method: Construct incomplete and contradictory review records that still appear polished to a human reader.
evidence: absence of a machine-enforced record validator before this run
findings: The protocol defines correct gates but cannot itself reject malformed records.
A record could claim publication readiness outside verification or without commit-matched evidence.
A safe-experiment statement could omit isolation, restoration, or scope boundaries.
repairs: Designed a fail-closed validator with checkpoint, evidence, rollback, risk, and experiment-safety invariants.
remaining_uncertainty: No repository command currently requires this validator before publication.
evidence_required_before_publication: Executed validator tests at the exact candidate commit
Integration of validation into the publication evidence path
phases.next_falsifiable_step: Execute the Node test file and retain exact-commit output.

phases.claim_or_design: The validator rejects the most dangerous false-positive review records while permitting safe reversible fixture failures.
phases.challenge_method: Add deterministic negative controls for wrong checkpoint, missing commit evidence, critical risk, forbidden experiment scope, and unsupported stronger verdict.
findings: Publication is now structurally limited to verification records.
Publication requires zero critical risks, commit-matched evidence, and reversed experiments.
Forbidden infrastructure scopes are rejected while disposable restored fixtures remain permitted.
repairs: Added fail-closed invariants and seven deterministic test cases.
remaining_uncertainty: Tests were authored but not executed through the GitHub connector.
String-enumerated forbidden scopes could miss semantically equivalent novel labels.
phases.rollback_route: Revert test commit 0ec887b22d0c201305f0d483b5609e32c03a095a and implementation commit 4e19edee7c8f82e2375e0ef208dbadcb2d5038e1.
evidence_required_before_publication: Review of scope vocabulary or migration to capability-based experiment permissions

phases.challenge_method: Separate code existence, test authorship, test execution, deployment identity, and publication readiness into independent claims.
evidence: GitHub commit receipts for implementation and test files
findings: Code and tests exist on preview at identified commits.
No executed test output, preview deployment object, accessibility evidence, performance evidence, or publication artifact was obtained.
Therefore publication readiness is not established.
repairs: Blocked publication and bounded the claim to committed implementation plus authored negative controls.
remaining_uncertainty: No publication-path integration has been proven.
phases.rollback_route: Revert this evidence commit, then 0ec887b22d0c201305f0d483b5609e32c03a095a and 4e19edee7c8f82e2375e0ef208dbadcb2d5038e1 on preview.
evidence_required_before_publication: Validator invocation from the publication verification path
Commit-matched preview and user-facing verification evidence for the actual creative surface
phases.next_falsifiable_step: Execute tests, then wire the validator into the publication evidence command and prove an incomplete record fails closed.
